protocol.task: At five minutes before a quarter-hour, predict final Binance minute close >= minute close immediately before interval opening
protocol.target: BTCUSDT close-price proxy; NOT BRTI averaging and NOT a Kalshi contract
protocol.selection: Fixed model settings; no hyperparameter or strategy selection
protocol.transfer: Existing September Kalshi validation rows only; already inspected development data
protocol.execution: Recomputed next-minute input, fixed 4-cent edge, 2-cent slippage, 0.07 fee assumption
limitations: Exchange closes differ from BRTI averages
Proxy test is not a trading-profit test
Transfer dates reused; no independent profitability claim

uncertainty.note: Exploratory day-block ratios including no-trade days; undefined zero-trade ratios excluded. Fixed historical fills, not a policy replay or reliable six-day edge test.
